note: Offline study: no network download. Every price/FX/CPI input is an existing committed research file, unchanged from band_h2_combo_v1; the SHA-256 values were re-computed in this worktree. Uses: stress_robustness_v1_{daily,dtb3}.csv (QQQ/SPY/QLD bars, DTB3), after_tax_tr_v1_{usdtry_cbrt,yiufe}.csv (TRY conversion, YI-UFE indexation), ewma_band_v1_{gspc,index,tb3ms}.csv (the six OOS windows). The TRY/YI-UFE calendar starts 2000-01 / 1999-01, so no after-tax stage starts before 2000-03-09. No 21-instrument stage is run. Three further entries are published evidence (not inputs): band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json (the K and C0 anchors), gain_band_v3/RESULTS.json and band_h2_combo_v1/H2_ANCHORS.json (the parent campaigns cells).
